question_answers.1_model_definition_location: stage7/stage8/stage8_1_700hpa_wind/run_official_odd_evaluation.py (lines 217-235) and run_stage8_1.py (lines 411-427). Model class: sklearn.ensemble.HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss='absolute_error', max_depth=4, min_samples_leaf=30, l2_regularization=10.0, random_state=42).
question_answers.2_model_state_location: NONE. No serialized fitted model artifact (.pkl / .joblib) exists on disk.
question_answers.3_can_fitted_model_be_loaded: NO. Loading a pre-fitted model binary is impossible because no model artifact was saved.
question_answers.5_causal_vs_noncausal_features: Astronomical and observation lag features are causal. However, NWP weather forecasts, Stage 6.6 satellite features, and Stage 8.1 700hpa steering wind features are ONLY present for 00:00 UTC origins in frozen data tables. They are MISSING for all non-00:00 UTC origins (01:00..23:00 UTC).
question_answers.6_prediction_row_meaning: One row represents predicted daytime surface downwelling shortwave radiation SW_IN (W/m^2) for target timestamp t_k + h (h in 1..24) given forecast origin t_k.
question_answers.7_why_origins_48h_apart: Because predictions in stage8_1_official_odd_predictions.csv were evaluated on 173 held-out ODD origins (which occur every 48 hours in the 2024 EVEN/ODD split).
question_answers.8_can_model_be_evaluated_at_arbitrary_or: NO. Input feature rows for non-00:00 UTC origins do not exist in frozen NWP, satellite, 700hpa wind, or Stage 4 prediction tables.
question_answers.9_can_complete_24h_forecast_be_generated: NO. Neither frozen prediction files nor frozen feature tables contain data for hourly MPC steps k=1..23.
question_answers.10_would_doing_so_require_retraining: YES. Creating a model operating on different origin intervals or without missing features would require retraining, which is STRICTLY PROHIBITED.
question_answers.11_would_doing_so_require_synthetic_fill: YES. Without retraining, generating 24h lookahead at k >= 1 would require synthetic filling, zero-padding, or future-origin prediction leakage—all strictly prohibited.
question_answers.14_missing_capability_or_artifact: 1) Missing serialized model checkpoint file (.pkl/.joblib). 2) Missing hourly feature inputs (NWP, satellite LWP/IWP, 700hPa wind, Stage 4 baseline) for non-00:00 UTC origins.
